subject: maths
question: A can complete a piece of work in 20 days, and B can do the same work in 30 days. If they work together for 5 days, what fraction of the work remains to be done?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total units (LCM of 20 and 30) = 60 units.

Efficiency: A = 60 ÷ 20 = 3 units/day, B = 60 ÷ 30 = 2 units/day.

Work done in 5 days = 5 × (3 + 2) = 25 units.

Remaining work = 60 − 25 = 35 units.

Remaining fraction = 35/60 = 7/12.

**∴ The correct option is (1).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 20 days

Time taken by B = 30 days

Time they worked together = 5 days

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time Taken

⇒ Efficiency of A = 60 ÷ 20 = 3 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of B = 60 ÷ 30 = 2 units/day

⇒ Total efficiency of (A + B) = 3 + 2 = 5 units/day

⇒ Work done in 5 days = 5 × 5 = 25 units

⇒ Remaining work = Total Work − Completed Work = 60 − 25 = 35 units

⇒ Fraction of work remaining = Remaining units ÷ Total units = 35/60 = 7/12

**∴ The correct option is (1).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns

Filling pipes act as positive efficiency and drainage pipes act as negative efficiency; total capacity is determined by LCM.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the work done or the ratio of efficiencies if all work for the same duration.

Alternate Day Work

Calculate work done in one cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 people) and then multiply to reach the total units.
